metadata.description: Claude Code setups for mobile stacks — Android, iOS, KMM, and Flutter. Each plugin ships opinionated skills, agents, and slash commands (including a from-zero /init-<stack>-app scaffolder).

plugins.name: cc-mobile-android
plugins.description: Android — Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, MVVM + Clean Architecture, Hilt, Retrofit + OkHttp + kotlinx.serialization, Room + DataStore, Navigation-Compose. Includes /init-android-app.

plugins.name: cc-mobile-ios
plugins.description: iOS — Swift + SwiftUI, MVVM + Clean Architecture, @Observable on @MainActor, URLSession + Codable, SwiftData + Keychain, NavigationStack typed routes. Includes /init-ios-app.

plugins.name: cc-mobile-kmm
plugins.description: Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile — shared module with MVVM + Clean Architecture in commonMain, Ktor Client + kotlinx.serialization, Koin DI, shared ViewModels over StateFlow, SQLDelight, multiplatform-settings. Includes /init-kmm-app.

plugins.name: cc-mobile-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter — Dart + Flutter, Clean Architecture, flutter_bloc + bloc_concurrency, freezed + fpdart (Either<Failure, T>), typed go_router, get_it, dio + OpenAPI client, drift + sqlcipher. Includes /init-flutter-app.
